answer_2.quote: We measure the diversity of generated sentences using token, sentence, and corpus-level evaluations. For factuality evaluation, we propose Item-wise Feature Matching Ratio (iFMR). To evaluate precision we adopt Feature Coverage Ratio (FCR) and Ground-Truth Feature Matching Ratio (GT-FMR). We also employ MAUVE to quantify the gap between generated explanations and human texts, and report BLEU-4 scores.
